sources.label: Gate GUSD proxy creation and role initialization

blacklistabilityReview.evidence: At Ethereum block 25774700, the proxy implementation remained 0xc181faf98a90993bba78af4a9d5dde37d3dbadaf. Its runtime exposes blockUser(address), unblockUser(address), freeze(address,uint256), blocked(address), frozen(address), pause(), and unpause(), alongside AccessControl role checks. The no-delay upgrader can also replace the token logic. GUSD therefore has direct holder-restriction capability; this result does not rely on an inference from centralized metadata.
